pack_name: KYE MAS Digital-Asset Treasury Authority Pack

claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted treasury decision involving a counterparty MUST evidence AML/CFT screening before execution. Unscreened counterparties refuse the decision at the action-admissibility gate.
Every AI-assisted digital-asset treasury decision MUST map to a named treasury-control owner under the prescribed risk-management authority. Absent designation refuses the decision.
Every treasury risk-limit decision MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding owner identity, the MAS obligation discharged, and Authority Finality outcome.
Every AI-assisted action that breaches a declared treasury risk limit MUST satisfy dual control. Single-actor breach-overrides are refused and routed dual-channel to the treasury-control owner.
